founders.title: Student Zero — the career-changer operating system.
founders.lead: Built by Enmanuel D. Mejia for people like him: bilingual IT support → Cloud / DevOps / fintech interviews. Greater Boston + Orlando targeting. Honest portfolio (SuperLab / Interstitium) — not inflated tenure, not invented employment.
learn.title: Outcomes first. Content second.
learn.lead: Video LMS platforms sell libraries. Interstitium ships a Curriculum OS: outcome cards, a skills taxonomy that orphans nothing, and a Student Zero path you can run locally. Scientia Omnia Vincit.
learn.why: Why this beats a video LMS
prep.title: Math → code → cloud. Then STAR.
prep.lead: Three phases aimed at Sr. Associate DevOps / fintech interview surfaces. Drills are prep — not employment claims.
play.title: Daily missions. Local XP. No account.
play.lead: Gamification at first-principles: checklists award XP, streaks feed the flame, badges unlock in-browser under il.game.v1. Prefers-reduced-motion keeps XP — kills particles.
enroll.title: Choose a path. Pay when live.
enroll.lead: Three tiers for Interstitium Labs static tracks. Checkout uses Stripe Payment Links and optional PayPal — configured in config.js.

labs.lead: Inspectable GitHub labs paired with the Curriculum OS. Portfolio and interview demos — not paid production tenure claims.
superlab.title: The flagship open portfolio lab.
superlab.lead: Portfolio lab (not paid production) — an interview-ready Kubernetes / GitOps / CI/CD / IaC demo. Not a customer production deployment.
superlab.students_title: A lab you can fail safely
adapt.title: Self-paced path that adapts to you.
adapt.lede: Placement probes ability (GMAT-inspired). Practice unlocks only the ready-to-learn fringe (ALEKS-inspired). Mastery lives in localStorage — no fake API keys, no 800 cloud VMs. Vendor certs deepen via the map.
adapt.status: Adaptive OS · local CAT + ALEKS fringe
adapt.cta.title: Continue adaptive path
adapt.cta.body: CAT placement + ALEKS ready-to-learn fringe run locally. Deepen official certs via the vendor map — we orchestrate, not clone.
adapt.flow.title: Instruction → check → feedback → next
adapt.flow.body: Wrong answers get Socratic tips — never an answer dump first. Prefer-reduced-motion safe. Mobile-first.
adapt.mini.title: One probe. Instant fringe signal.
model.kicker: Model router · Scale relative to demand
model.title: Lab LLM switcher
model.lede: T0 local P920 (3B GPU / 7B CPU) → T1 extra CPU hosts → T2 remote OSS. Auto-switch only among healthy models. Never claim 70B local GPU.
muse.kicker: Noah · assistant and tutor · on this device
muse.title: Your lab-aware coach.
muse.lead: One long main chat, side chats for topics, goals & ideas, rich artifacts, and browser voice. Lean model router — scale when demand grows. Inspired by a public assistant interaction design; educational agent, not Meta’s product.
muse.warmup_body: Attempt a card first. Bring Noah your hypothesis — not “just give me the answer.”
muse.voice_unsupported: Voice unsupported in this browser. Text still works. Chrome/Edge recommended for Web Speech.
demo.title: Place → drill → Noah door.
demo.lede: Not FX theater. A real adaptive probe, one SuperLab-shaped check, then Socratic handoff.
paths.dir_title: Paths that beat the catalog sites on architecture
paths.dir_lead: Every card answers what will I be able to DO? Phases · Adapt gates · SuperLab proof · Noah side-quests · evidence portfolio. We clone path architecture from peers — not course text, videos, or trademarks. No fake hundreds of courses.
paths.vs_peers: Vs KodeKloud · ALEKS · Brilliant · Khan · Codecademy · LF · RH · Oracle · AWS Skill Builder
paths.pill_outcomes_body: First screen = measurable capability, not a binge library.

paths.pill_proof_body: SuperLab hooks + local evidence log — honesty over fleet wallpaper.
